title: Exto
description: This mod adds a unique horror mod boss that has a rare chance of spawning in the dark forest, the badlands etc.
body:
Exto adds a new rare and dangerous hostile mob to your Minecraft world.
Lurking in the Dark Forest and the Badlands, the Exto attacks players on sight. Its rare spawn rate makes every encounter feel like a genuine threat — you never know when one might be nearby.
Features:

Spawns in Dark Forests, dungeons, and the Badlands
Rare spawn rate
Attacks players on sight
May spawn with a mate

Requirements:

NeoForge
Minecraft 1.21.1

Keep your eyes open — the Exto doesn't forgive careless adventurers.
